description: This PHP source file defines the ADODB_Pager class responsible for implementing pagination of database recordsets, including navigation links (First, Previous, Next, Last) and rendering options for a paginated view within a web application.

classes.name: ADODB_Pager
classes.description: A PHP class providing functionality to paginate database query results and generate navigation controls in web pages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initialize the pager with database connection, SQL query, and configuration options.

methods.name: Render_First
methods.description: Render a link to the first page of results.

methods.name: render_next
methods.description: Render a link to the next page of results.

methods.name: render_last
methods.description: Render a link to the last page of results.

methods.name: render_pagelinks
methods.description: Render individual page number links for navigation.

methods.name: render_prev
methods.description: Render a link to the previous page of results.

methods.name: RenderGrid
methods.description: Generate HTML for the current recordset in grid format, using an external rs2html function.

methods.name: RenderNav
methods.description: Generate the complete navigation bar for pagination controls.

methods.name: RenderPageCount
methods.description: Display current page and total page count.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to execute the paginated query, fetch results, and display the grid with navigation.

methods.name: RenderLayout
methods.description: Render overall layout wrapping header, grid, and footer.
